onboarding.title: Start with your calendar
onboarding.connectLine: Connect iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail or any CalDAV server.
onboarding.dataStays: Your data stays in your browser.
onboarding.howText: Calino has no backend of its own. It talks directly to your CalDAV server and stores a copy locally. You can back up or move your data with export/import in Settings.
onboarding.nativeFootnote: Calino can remind you before events start. Continuing will ask for notification permission.
onboarding.alsoOnAndroid: Also on <link>Android</link>, with camera import and reminders.
